div.style: color: rgb(56, 36, 84) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
LangGraph plan_allocation - CURRENT
Invoke deterministic Python; no LLM choice or arithmetic

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Use same-run state or an explicitly named saved run
Plan current verified tasks; account for missing outcomes
Label an incomplete processing run as partial

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Plan earliest deadline first - CURRENT modules
Equal deadlines retain source order
Begin with a copy of the starting workshop queues

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: Take next task using the evolving tentative queues

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: Supported ready allocation task?

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Information question or unsupported intent
Record outcome; do not allocate

div.style: color: rgb(86, 59, 21) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Review or clarification
Missing facts, duplicate order requests,
unsupported split/condition or failed verification
No queue reservation

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Are they allowed to?
Active status, batch cap,
requested destination and exclusions

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Can they make it?
Product category matches workshop capability

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Can they take it now?
Current queue and capacity
Production, expected rework and pickup lead
Deterministic completion and deadline checks

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Calculate comparison values in code
Cost, defect rate, delivery time,
lateness and workload concentration where relevant

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: Allowed on-time candidate exists?

div.style: color: rgb(86, 59, 21) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Record feasibility review
Show deterministic rejection reasons
Closest late option or unrestricted alternative is information only

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rank feasible candidates in code
Default: delivery time then cost
Cheapest or quality-first when requested
Policy experiments remain separate; no invented weights

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p: Winning workshop's recorded role is clear?

div.style: color: rgb(86, 59, 21) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Ambiguous reference-only winner
Request dispatcher review
No silent destination substitution

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Build recommendation and reserve tentative queue time
Add production and expected rework to the queue copy
Pickup transport is outside production occupancy

div.style: color: rgb(41, 52, 68) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Save a decision row
Selected option, candidate/rejection evidence,
precomputed metrics, policy and input snapshots

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: More tasks?

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Compute related-review warnings without changing selection
Warned summary rows become provisional
Recommended work still reserves tentative queue time

div.style: color: rgb(41, 52, 68) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center; width: 420px;

span.p:
Saved plan and timestamped history - CURRENT
Decisions, provisional summaries and review_warnings
Processing completeness, missing outcomes and queue copies

div.style: color: rgb(20, 46, 81) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PLANNED dispatcher console
Inspect evidence, alternatives and calculated trade-offs

div.style: color: rgb(22, 63, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PLANNED live confirmation and atomic commit
Recheck current task, order and queue state
Persistent assignments are a separate workflow

div.style: color: rgb(41, 52, 68) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CURRENT controlled snapshot
Order/workshop CSVs and initial queues
